evidence.fact: Elevation gain 3,150 feet, 8.0 miles roundtrip, highest point 3,900 ft
3,150 feet of elevation gain on the ascent (DNR-managed National Recreation Trail application)

wa_mount_si_trail.note: Ledger-only lock of stored 3150 (shape outback, so one-way gain). Both pages give 3,150 ft; WTA highest point is 3,900 ft (trail-end viewpoint below the 4,167 Haystack). WTA prose also says "gaining 3,100 feet". No loss/regain stated anywhere.

evidence.fact: Upper trailhead (3,500 ft): 2,444 feet gained in 1.6 miles to the summit

wa_mount_ellinor_standard.note: Ledger-only lock of stored 2444 (upper trailhead). WTA stats block (3,300 ft, 6.2 mi rt) is the LOWER trailhead. theoutbound.com summit-mount-ellinor lists 2467 ft over 3.08 mi but does not name the trailhead, so not counted as a second source.

evidence.fact: NPS: 6,600 ft gain, 7.7 mi one way High Bridge to summit

wa_mcgregor_mountain_scramble.note: Stored 6,200 is within 10% of NPS 6,600 ft (High Bridge to summit), so the stored value is locked on one source. The NPS places page says 5,700 ft to the end of the trail plus a 1,000 ft scramble; not used, because it would need adding. If a second source confirms 6,600, consider replacing the stored value.

evidence.fact: FKT: loop from Bridge Creek TH, 38.3 mi, 10,700 ft vertical gain

wa_mount_goode_northeast_buttress.note: Loop shape: the FKT figure covers the whole loop (Bridge Creek, NE Buttress, Park Creek, then the PCT back). FKT calls the approach ~13 mi of flat or gradual downhill but gives no loss figure. Mountaineers (8,400) and the CascadeClimbers TR (9,700) were blocked.

evidence.fact: Kamikaze trail to Mt Teneriffe: 6.5 mi total, 3800 ft total ascent

wa_mount_teneriffe_kamikaze_trail.note: Stored 3800 matches. WTA mount-teneriffe also says 3,800 ft but that is the 13-mile road route, not Kamikaze, so not used as a second source. 10adventures Kamikaze figure is 1,265 m round-trip metric only.

evidence.fact: 2,300 ft elevation gain, 5.4 mi roundtrip, high point 5,327 ft
Elevation gain 2,300 feet in trail details box; no source credited

wa_mount_pilchuck_standard_route.note: Stored 2300 matches WTA and The Herald exactly; ledger-only lock. Neither page states an approach loss.

evidence.fact: 725 ft elevation gain, 2.6 mi roundtrip, high point 5,700 ft

wa_table_mountain_standard_scramble.note: Stored 725 matches WTA. 10adventures gives 183 m only (metres-only, not usable). USFS Trail 681 page states no gain.

evidence.fact: 800' elevation loss dropping to Upper Garfield Mountain Lake on the way to Treen, via Green Ridge from Middle Fork Road

wa_treen_peak_scramble.note: Same page gives 6,115 ft car-to-car total gain (includes regaining the 800 ft), so not used as trailhead-to-summit gain; stored 6100 likely equals that round-trip total and may overstate. Regain not stated as a number. Mountaineers 4,400 ft (403, unopened).

evidence.fact: 4,600' of climbing from parking lot to summit

wa_johannesburg_mountain_northeast_rib_1.note: Ledger-only lock of stored 5000 against Abegg's 4,600 ft parking-to-summit (8% off). return_gain 1500 is the gain on her descent via C-J Col and Doug's Direct; valid only if our descent is that standard one. Page gives approach as 3500' gain with no loss stated, so approach_loss not set.

evidence.fact: 3,200 ft gain, Alpental to Snoqualmie Mountain summit via the pass

wa_snoqualmie_mountain_standard_route.note: Ledger-only lock of stored 3105: yellowleaf trip log states 3,200 ft (within 10%). Mountaineers listings (~3,200 ft) are 403; WTA has no hike page. No page states approach loss/return gain.

evidence.fact: Big Snagtooth: elevation gain 4,000 ft, highest point 8,330 ft

wa_big_snagtooth_west_ridge.note: WTA hike page states 4,000 ft gain, equal to stored. Ledger-only lock of the stored value. Mountaineers listing (4,500 ft) not openable (403).

evidence.fact: Fremont Glacier route: gain 8,900 ft, 47 mi round trip (credited to The Mountaineers)

wa_mount_logan_fremont_glacier.note: Blog quotes The Mountaineers route figure 8,900 ft (Thunder Creek approach) = stored; counts as one source (The Mountaineers). Ledger-only lock. Lemke Climbs report uses Park Creek approach and states no total gain.

evidence.fact: Boulder Glacier route: about 8,300 ft from 2,723 ft trailhead to 10,778 ft summit

wa_mount_baker_boulder_glacier.note: Next Adventure states ~8,300 ft (table 8,328 ft) trailhead to summit, within 10% of stored 8,100; ledger-only lock of stored. Mountaineers 8,100 ft not openable (403). USFS route page states no gain.

evidence.fact: Pinnacle Mountain (Entiat), North Fork Entiat TH: elevation gain 5,722 ft, high point 8,402 ft

wa_pinnacle_mountain_entiat_scramble.note: WTA states 5,722 ft, exactly the stored value. Ledger-only lock. Wenatchee Outdoors pages returned 403; a SummitPost figure (~4,600 ft to Borealis Pass) seen only in search results, not opened.

wa_enchantment_enchainment.note: FKT route page states 18,400 ft for the 9-summit loop, exactly the stored whole-outing value. Ledger-only lock.
